## Description

Provide a clear and concise summary of the changes introduced in this PR.

Fixes #(issue number)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring / Performance improvement

## Checklist

- [ ] My code adheres to the project's style guidelines (`uv run ruff check .` and `uv run ruff format --check .`)
- [ ] My code passes strict type checking (`uv run mypy src`) with 0 errors
- [ ] I have added unit tests proving my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally (`uv run pytest`)
- [ ] I have updated corresponding documentation in `docs/` and `ARCHITECTURE.md` if applicable
- [ ] I have added an entry to `CHANGELOG.md` under `[Unreleased]`
